Pregnancy After 35 Is It Prone to Complications Dr Jyotshna Palgamkar Breaks It Down

The article on HealthAndMe put a question a lot of women are quietly asking. Is thirty five really a fertility cliff? The honest answer from Dr Jyotshna Palgamkar, Fertility Specialist at Nova IVF Fertility, Virar, Mumbai is no, it is not a cliff. But it is a threshold where things shift. Egg reserve drops. Complications like gestational diabetes and blood pressure become more common. And the chance of chromosomal issues rises.
